comments.author: Paul_Foster
comments.body_html:
I first downloaded another clothing modpack but tried to change to yours because it looked better. But now i cant change clothes because I see [BROKEN_DROPDOWN] top and on bottom.

After i try see my character i cant go back to GEAR, HEALTH, SKILLS, MAP, TASKS, ACHIEVEMENTS.

SOLVED: go \SPT_Data\Server\configs\core.json and changed “removeModItemsFromProfile” to “true”. Which the server terminal reported. Worked.
